title_en: 56 Tangtang the Witch Hosts a Party
page_text_ocr_zh:

page_text_en:
If the world were the most barbaric, you'd bring coconuts—how fragrant and fresh! With several incense sticks, bubbling over, Tangtang Witch named this most unique soup 'Fresh-Fresh Clear-Clear Soup'.
Tangtang Witch Invites Guests
If anyone comes, how fragrant and fresh! White, like mermaids. Shaking head, black fish. Beef, mutton, fish, fresh; add some yellow croaker and black fish fillets. Boom boom boom, Tangtang Witch lifted the pot lid, fish
summary_zh: 本页为绘本第一页，标题为《汤汤巫婆请客》，介绍了汤汤巫婆制作一道名为“鲜鲜清清汤”的奇特汤品，并开始邀请客人，画面呈现巫婆形象和文字描述。

title_en: 56 Tangtang the Witch Hosts a Party
page_text_ocr_zh:
汤汤巫婆是位好客的巫婆。
她时常请她的邻居灰灰刺猬、白
毛兔、红尾巴松鼠和黑黑熊来吃她做的菜。
汤汤巫婆最爱煲汤了。她最拿手
的是陈年干蘑菇烧鲜泥鳅汤，她说这
是全世界最好喝的汤。你想想干蘑
菇多香多鲜啊，鲜泥鳅身上滑溜溜
的，汤汤巫婆把这道很奇特的汤叫作
“鲜鲜滑滑汤”。
page_text_en:
Tangtang Witch is a hospitable witch.
She often invites her neighbors—Gray Gray Hedgehog, White Rabbit, Red-Tailed Squirrel, and Black Bear—to eat her dishes.
Tangtang Witch loves making soup. Her specialty is aged dried mushroom stewed with fresh loaches. She says this is the best soup in the world. Imagine how fragrant and fresh the dried mushrooms are, and how slippery the fresh loaches are. Tangtang Witch calls this unique soup "Fresh and Slippery Soup."
summary_zh: 本页介绍了汤汤巫婆的厨艺和她最拿手的汤品——陈年干蘑菇烧鲜泥鳅汤，并说明她将这道汤命名为“鲜鲜滑滑汤”，同时展示了她邀请邻居们来品尝的场景。

title_en: 56 Tangtang the Witch Hosts a Party
page_text_ocr_zh:
当客人坐下时，汤汤巫婆给每人
盛上一大碗汤。

可是说老实话，在座的客人没有一个喜欢喝这种汤。因为这汤里的陈年蘑菇有股霉味儿，滑溜溜的泥鳅身上有股土腥味儿。

灰刺猬捏着鼻子喝下了这碗汤。
白毛兔闭上眼睛喝下了这碗汤。

红尾巴松鼠一边喝汤，一边用他蓬松的大尾巴遮住脸，不让汤汤巫婆看到他龇牙咧嘴的痛苦表情。

黑黑熊呢，又捏鼻子又闭眼睛才喝下半碗汤，另外半碗被他偷偷泼在了地上。
page_text_en:
When the guests sat down, Tangtang Witch served each of them a big bowl of soup.

But to be honest, none of the guests liked this soup. Because the aged mushrooms in it had a musty smell, and the slippery loaches had an earthy odor.

The gray hedgehog pinched his nose and drank the bowl of soup.
The white rabbit closed his eyes and drank the bowl of soup.

The red-tailed squirrel drank the soup while using his fluffy tail to cover his face, so Tangtang Witch couldn't see his pained, grimacing expression.

As for Black Bear, he pinched his nose and closed his eyes before drinking half the bowl, and secretly poured the other half on the ground.
summary_zh: 汤汤巫婆为客人盛上她制作的汤，但因汤有霉味和土腥味，客人们纷纷表现出厌恶，有的捏鼻子喝，有的闭眼喝，红尾巴松鼠用尾巴遮脸，黑黑熊则偷偷把半碗汤泼在地上。

title_en: 56 Tangtang the Witch Hosts a Party
page_text_ocr_zh:
汤汤巫婆瞧着大伙儿桌前空空的碗，还以为大家很喜欢喝呢。
没过几天，汤汤巫婆又请大伙儿喝汤了。这次大家都说肚子很饱，每人只喝下一小口，汤汤巫婆就把剩下的汤全喝了，她的肚子被鲜鲜滑滑汤灌成了一个大皮球……

当汤汤巫婆第三次请大家喝汤时，谁也不肯上门。

在红尾巴松鼠家门口，汤汤巫婆一把拽住松鼠的大尾巴，生气地说：“你们这群没良心的小东西，我煲了那么好喝的汤，你们都不肯上门。我要把你们变成四只小花碗，让你们每天都喝我的鲜鲜滑滑汤。”
page_text_en:
The witch Tangtang looked at the empty bowls in front of everyone and thought they really liked drinking it.

A few days later, Witch Tangtang invited everyone to drink soup again. This time, everyone said they were full, and each person only took a small sip. Tangtang then drank all the remaining soup, and her stomach was filled with the fresh, slippery soup, turning into a big ball...

When Witch Tangtang invited everyone for soup for the third time, no one was willing to come.

At the door of the red-tailed squirrel, Witch Tangtang grabbed the squirrel's big tail and angrily said, "You bunch of heartless little creatures, I've cooked such delicious soup, but you won't even come. I'll turn you into four little flower bowls, so you can drink my fresh, slippery soup every day."
summary_zh: 汤汤巫婆因客人只喝一小口汤便离开，自己喝光剩余汤品，肚子胀成大皮球；第三次请客时无人上门，她在红尾巴松鼠家门口生气地威胁要将客人变成小花碗，强迫他们喝汤。

title_en: 56 Tangtang the Witch Hosts a Party
page_text_ocr_zh:
zhāo jí
小松鼠吓坏了，他赶快把这个可怕的消息告诉了伙伴们。伙伴们也都很着急，谁也不愿意做一只天天盛满鲜鲜滑滑汤的可怜小碗。
他们一起商量，要想出一个既不让汤汤巫婆生气，又不用喝这难喝的汤的办法。

这个时候，小兔的聪明脑子特别管用，他和大伙儿一咬耳朵，大伙儿都连声叫好。
第二天，四个伙伴高高兴兴地来到汤汤巫婆的家中。
page_text_en:
zhāo jí
The little squirrel was terrified, so he quickly told his friends the terrible news. The friends were also very anxious; no one wanted to be a poor little bowl filled with fresh, slippery soup every day.
They discussed together, trying to come up with a way that would not make the witch Tangtang angry, yet also avoid having to drink this unpleasant soup.

At this moment, the little rabbit's clever brain came in handy. He whispered to the others, and everyone immediately agreed.
The next day, the four friends happily arrived at Witch Tangtang's house.
summary_zh: 小松鼠将汤汤巫婆请客的可怕消息告诉伙伴们，大家不愿喝难喝的汤，于是商量对策；小兔想出办法，第二天四个伙伴高高兴兴地来到汤汤巫婆家。

title_en: 56 Tangtang the Witch Hosts a Party
page_text_ocr_zh:
当汤汤巫婆刚想盛上她的鲜鲜滑滑汤时，四位客人一起说：“请等一下，我们还带来自己做的一点小点心。我们吃完了这些，再喝你的汤吧！”

灰灰刺猬拿出的是几个鲜蘑菇菜包；白毛兔拿出的是红薯白萝卜甜糕；红尾巴松鼠端上一碗核桃桃子香浓汤；黑黑熊呢，捧出几个苹果蜜汁馅饼。

他们把这几道点心吃了一半，拍拍

肚子说：“撑死了，撑死了，我们再也吃不下了！”

然后，一个个溜走了。

汤汤巫婆尝尝他们剩下的点心，觉得一个比一个好吃，她从来没吃过那么香甜美味的东西。

bā ji bō ji
page_text_en:
When Tangtang Witch was about to serve her fresh and slippery soup, the four guests said together: "Wait a moment, we've brought some small snacks we made ourselves. We'll finish these first, then drink your soup!"

Huihui Hedgehog took out several fresh mushroom buns; Bai Mao Tu brought sweet yam and white radish cakes; Hongwei Squirrel served a bowl of walnut and peach fragrant soup; and Heihei Bear presented several apple honey-filled pastries.

They ate half of these snacks, then patted their

bellies and said: "We're stuffed, stuffed! We can't eat another bite!"

Then, one by one, they slipped away.

Tangtang Witch tasted the leftover snacks and found each one tastier than the last. She had never eaten anything so delicious and sweet before.

bā ji bō ji
summary_zh: 汤汤巫婆准备请客，四位客人带来了各自制作的点心，吃了一半后表示吃撑了，便纷纷离开。汤汤巫婆品尝了客人剩下的点心，觉得非常美味。

title_en: 56 Tangtang the Witch Hosts a Party
page_text_ocr_zh:
打这以后，汤汤巫婆开始学习制作这些美味食品。以后她请客时，都少不了鲜蘑菇菜包、红薯白萝卜甜糕、核桃松子香浓汤，还有苹果蜜汁馅饼。她的每位客人都吃得肚子圆溜溜的，像个大皮球。
至于那难喝的鲜鲜滑滑汤呢，汤汤巫婆一次也没有端上来，她早把它忘在脑后了……
page_text_en:
After this, Tangtang Witch began learning to make these delicious foods. When she invited guests afterward, she always had fresh mushroom vegetable buns, sweet potato and white radish cakes, walnut and pine nut rich soup, and apple honey-filled pastries. Every guest ate until their stomachs were round and full, like big balls.
As for that unpleasant-tasting 'Fresh and Slippery Soup', Tangtang Witch never served it once—she had long forgotten about it...
summary_zh: 汤汤巫婆学会制作多种美味食品，招待客人时都受到欢迎，而她之前制作的难喝的鲜鲜滑滑汤则被彻底遗忘。
